name: mcp-timezone
description: Time zones, meeting slots and calendar invites for people who work with clients abroad. Convert times, find hours that suit everyone, check DST, write .ics. All local.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: now
tools.description: The current time in one or more places. Accepts IANA zones (Europe/Warsaw), city names (Warsaw), country names (Poland) or abbreviations (PST, IST). With no zones it reports this machine's local zone and UTC.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a time from one place to others. The input time is read as wall-clock time in from_zone unless it carries an offset or a trailing Z. Accepts '2026-09-10 15:00', an ISO timestamp, or a phrase like '3pm tomorrow'.

tools.name: overlap
tools.description: The window each day when every listed place is inside working hours. Computed on a real date, so a DST week that widens or narrows the overlap is reflected.

tools.name: find_meeting_slots
tools.description: Rank the times when every participant is inside their own working hours. Returns each slot as a UTC instant with the local time for every participant and a fairness score, best first.

tools.name: dst_changes
tools.description: The clock changes in a place for a year, with the exact UTC instant and the offset before and after. Use it to check whether a recurring call moves for one of you in March or October.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count the business days between two dates in a place, for delivery dates and payment terms. Returns the business-day count, the calendar total, and how many days fell on a weekend or on a holiday you passed.

tools.name: contacts_set
tools.description: Remember a client or teammate's time zone and working hours so you can say 'find a slot with Maria and Raj' later.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: Everyone you have saved, with their current local time and whether they are inside working hours right now.

tools.name: ics_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write a .ics calendar file for one meeting. Returns the path written and the meeting time in UTC and in the zone you gave.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
